desc:
A chill cozy game about baking bread to buy your freedom from the kitchen! 🍞

It's closing time and Chef Crumb won't open the door until the day's quota is baked. Time to get kneading!

🥖 Grab dough, cut it and send it down the oven belt
💰 Sell fresh bread at the counter and earn cash
🔧 Upgrade your tools, backpack and table, from bare hands to industrial machines
🐶 Adopt pets that work the line for you: Dough Pup, Cocoa Cat and Oven Dragon
🎰 Roll classes with special perks
🌙 Pick your shift: Day, Overtime, Night or Holiday Rush
💎 Earn gems with daily and playtime rewards
👫 Bake solo or with up to 3 friends

Can you hit the quota and escape in time? ⏰
